verses.english: “Mendicants, you should know bad principles with bad results.
And you should know good principles with good results.

verses.pali: Adhammañca viditvā anatthañca, dhammañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabbaṁ.
verses.english: Knowing these things, your practice should follow the good principles with good results.

verses.pali: Katamo ca, bhikkhave, adhammo ca anattho ca?
verses.english: And what are bad principles with bad results?

verses.pali: Pāṇātipāto, adinnādānaṁ, kāmesumicchācāro, musāvādo, pisuṇā vācā, pharusā vācā, samphappalāpo, abhijjhā, byāpādo, micchādiṭṭhi—
verses.english: Killing living creatures, stealing, and sexual misconduct; speech that’s false, backbiting, harsh, or nonsensical; covetousness, ill will, and wrong view.

verses.pali: ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, adhammo ca anattho ca.
verses.english: These are called bad principles with bad results.

verses.pali: Katamo ca, bhikkhave, dhammo ca attho ca?
verses.english: And what are good principles with good results?

verses.pali: Pāṇātipātā veramaṇī, adinnādānā veramaṇī, kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇī, musāvādā veramaṇī, pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇī, pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī, samphappalāpā veramaṇī, anabhijjhā, abyāpādo, sammādiṭṭhi—
verses.english: Avoiding killing living creatures, stealing, and sexual misconduct; avoiding speech that’s false, backbiting, harsh, or nonsensical; contentment, good will, and right view.

verses.pali: ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, dhammo ca attho ca.
verses.english: These are called good principles with good results.
‘You should know bad principles with bad results.
And you should know good principles with good results.

verses.pali: Adhammañca viditvā anatthañca, dhammañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabban’ti,
verses.english: Knowing these things, your practice should follow the good principles with good results.’

verses.pali: iti yaṁ taṁ vuttaṁ, idametaṁ paṭicca vuttan”ti.
verses.english: That’s what I said, and this is why I said it.”
